title: Quest Sports Tournament 2027
resources: Lab access, projectors, certificates and volunteer coordination

claims.claim_text: We anticipate around 212 attendees for this first-of-its-kind Sports Tournament for our club.
The requested budget of INR 46,000 is realistic and sufficient for this Sports Tournament.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
This event will improve campus community spirit and student wellbeing.
